title: Bind an odd-multiplicity successor for the even scatter duplicate
body:
## Summary
- The published replay XORs a retained total once per occurrence. The frozen exporter emits one ADD when the index is present.
- Appending `[0, 0]` to the first selected row makes the replay coefficient `0` and the frozen export `1`. An odd-multiplicity successor emits `0` on that duplicate and `1` on an odd triple.
- The successor matches the replay on the selected word. The frozen exporter is unchanged. No selected frontier change and no new exponent.
